name: exchange-calendars-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is exchange_calendars, a Python library of trading calendars for securities
exchanges: for each exchange it provides sessions, trading minutes, open/close and break times, holidays
and trading indexes, built on pandas.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the exchange_calendars package: every module under exchange_calendars/ (the ExchangeCalendar base class and its helpers, the calendar registry and utilities, the holiday and lunisolar modules, pandas_extensions/, utils/ and the calendar module of every individual exchange), together with the page README.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is that page and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.11 with no network access. exchange_calendars is imported from `/workdir`
(it is on `PYTHONPATH`, and the `ecal` command runs its command-line module); its dependencies (pandas,
numpy, pyluach, toolz, tzdata and korean_lunar_calendar) and pytest and hypothesis are installed
